frequency_question: How often do states successfully sign successor resource treaties before expiration when both face absolute dependency on the resource?
membership_rule: Includes formal bilateral river basin or shared water treaties coming up for renewal or requiring a successor pact; excludes unilateral declarations or failed negotiations where no treaty resulted.

cases.name: US-Canada Columbia River Treaty regime extensions/discussions

Botswana-Namibia Okavango River Basin Commission protocols

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 6 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 6 named cases; represents the core subset of major riparian neighbors with highly institutionalized, existential water sharing regimes.
known_gaps: Excludes minor bilateral arrangements without public treaty status.
skeleton: 6 known major transboundary river treaty renewals or structured updates within operational windows, all resulting in formal signed instruments.
validity_reason: Transboundary water diplomacy norms and existential agricultural/population dependencies change slowly over multi-decade scales.
